NO_DATA_AVAILABLE items (50/200 SMA, macro, global news, prediction markets, TTM/forward multiples) are correctly reported as UNKNOWN rather than fabricated. Minor imprecision: the report calls 298.9M "the largest volume print in the entire 82-row history" — it is the largest in the retrieved window, which is accurate as stated. Relevance: tightly focused on NVDA at 2026-08-27, with a clear final decision (Overweight, staged entry, defined stop) and no off-topic drift; some redundancy across the four risk-seat sections but core is complete. Semantic validity: the report is exemplary on period/unit discipline — it explicitly labels EPS 2.46/2.22 as single-quarter fiscal Q2 2027 figures, explicitly declines to annualize (2.22×4) or construct a TTM EPS, and states trailing P/E is UNKNOWN. No trailing ratio is computed from quarterly EPS, and no key numerical valuation assertion is unsupported. Citation accounting: cited claims are numerous and each cited source ID (src-nvda, market-nvda) genuinely backs the specific claim it is attached to; no invalid citations found.
